to: plan and run --plan disagree about the order inside one wave

The authored order of a wave BINDS the dispatcher, rather than being presentation only. Weighed: a wave is an order (TL-206 settled that between waves) and inside one it is the only place an author can say B reads A's correction, priority being a property of a task and not of its position; the rejected reading keeps the priority sort and makes plan's next up a sequence printed from a set. Priority still ranks everything the plan does not schedule, so nothing is lost.
